title: Three generations, one reader
description: The header says which family an archive is. After that, listing, lookup, reading and extraction are the same calls for all of them.

nodes.title: Any supported archive
nodes.detail: Morrowind's BSA, the TES4 BSA of Oblivion through Skyrim SE, and the BA2 of Fallout 4 through Starfield.

nodes.title: Archive
nodes.detail: Detects the family, indexes every entry by path and hash, and reads straight from a memory-mapped file.

nodes.title: Bytes, readers, files
nodes.detail: A Vec, a std::io::Read, or a directory tree written one file at a time, each file atomically.

nodes.title: Builders
nodes.detail: Write TES3, TES4 and BA2 archives from bytes, files, directories, or entries of another archive.

nodes.title: Luau scripts
nodes.detail: require("@dream/archive") gives scripts the same reader and builders through l3i.
